Workflow.Name: RFP - Verify OCR Requirement
Workflow.Description: OCR verification card with a page-image crop; records the verified text and resumes the pipeline.

Description.description: OCR verification card with a page-image crop; records the verified text and resumes the pipeline.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Explain Answer
Workflow.Description: Why a requirement was answered as it was: compliance value, the approved library answer ID, the response text, or the gap if no approved answer existed.

Description.description: Why a requirement was answered as it was: compliance value, the approved library answer ID, the response text, or the gap if no approved answer existed.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Explain Flag
Workflow.Description: Every flag on one requirement: type, severity, the policy rule and its approved position, and the reason.

Description.description: Every flag on one requirement: type, severity, the policy rule and its approved position, and the reason.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Get Run Status
Workflow.Description: Where an RFP is in the pipeline, what it is waiting for, and its recent run log.

Description.description: Where an RFP is in the pipeline, what it is waiting for, and its recent run log.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Rerun Stage
Workflow.Description: Rerun an RFP's pipeline from a stage (1-9). Refused while the pipeline is running or after the RFP is filed.

Description.description: Rerun an RFP's pipeline from a stage (1-9). Refused while the pipeline is running or after the RFP is filed.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Hook Post Tool Use
Workflow.Description: Hook: write an audit row for every RFP Orchestrator tool call.

Description.description: Hook: write an audit row for every RFP Orchestrator tool call.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Hook Pre Tool Use
Workflow.Description: Hook: deny an RFP rerun while the pipeline is running, after filing, or for a stage outside 1-9.

Description.description: Hook: deny an RFP rerun while the pipeline is running, after filing, or for a stage outside 1-9.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Receive Inbound Document
Workflow.Description: New file in the Inbound folder -> hrs_rfp, revision 0 and document rows; starts the pipeline.

Description.description: New file in the Inbound folder -> hrs_rfp, revision 0 and document rows; starts the pipeline.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Request Approval
Workflow.Description: Single approval (9.3): card to the pilot recipient, waits with reminder and escalation; approve files the package, reject returns to assembly.

Description.description: Single approval (9.3): card to the pilot recipient, waits with reminder and escalation; approve files the package, reject returns to assembly.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Route Gap To SME
Workflow.Description: Gap card to the pilot recipient (Q6), waits with reminder and escalation, records the answer and proposes a Draft library entry.

Description.description: Gap card to the pilot recipient (Q6), waits with reminder and escalation, records the answer and proposes a Draft library entry.

Workflow.Name: RFP - Run Pipeline
Workflow.Description: Runs every stage after hrs_stage when an RFP is set to Running (ADR-0001, ADR-0018).

Description.description: Runs every stage after hrs_stage when an RFP is set to Running (ADR-0001, ADR-0018).
